notes.title: Spicy Family Tensions Await!
notes.content:
[h3]You inherit a failing motel, but there’s a catch: your flirty stepsister is already living there.
Manage repairs, cook breakfast, and navigate a month of heated moments and tough choices. Will you save the motel… and your relationship with Billie? 🍑

The tension is rising, and so is something else. Get ready for a wild ride! 😏

[b]👉 Wishlist now[/b][/h3]
